findings.text: When _actionHandler exists but this.parent is null/undefined, the command event is never emitted anywhere (original this.emit removed, new parent.emit skipped). Input: a root command with _actionHandler and no parent will silently drop the command event, breaking any listeners expecting 'command:<name>' events.

The else-if chain structure means when _actionHandler exists, the fallback to command:* wildcard handling (lines 1507-1510) is never reached even if parent lacks the specific command listener. Input: a subcommand with _actionHandler where parent has no listener for 'command:subcmd' but does have 'command:*' listener will fail to trigger the wildcard handler.

0.reason: The code removes the unconditional emit and only emits via parent, so a root command with an action handler and no parent will never emit the command event, which is a genuine behavioral regression.

1.reason: The else-if structure prevents the command:* wildcard fallback from being reached when an action handler exists, even if the parent has no specific listener but does have a wildcard listener, which is a genuine defect.
